description: Emergency department encounter with date-precision period and a SNOMED CT type code, exercising the clinical:EncounterShape added in clinical v1.14
notes: Fully synthetic. clinical:Encounter was defined in clinical v1.7 and targeted by no shape until v1.14, so encounter-001 sat in KNOWN_FAILURES as UNSHAPED: it reported conforming while evaluating zero constraints. encounterClass 'EMER' is deliberately a v3-ActCode abbreviation rather than a display word, because the shape imposes no enum there (FHIR binds Encounter.class extensibly).
